prompt: The dashboard in this service has got slow and nobody knows why. Assess the repository and write the assessment to ASSESSMENT.md. Do not change the code.

assertions.description: The per-order customer query inside the loop is reported with evidence
The customer_id filter with no supporting index is reported
The migration was read to establish which indexes exist
The unanchored LIKE that cannot use an index is reported with evidence
The ORDER BY placed_at with no index is reported
The constant-factor defect is separated from the ones that scale with row count
The ranking is labelled as unmeasured and what would measure it is named
The declared test command was run and its output recorded
No injection vector is claimed where every query is parameterised
The audited files are left byte-identical
What was not examined is named rather than assumed safe
